name: per-datum-egress-post-allowed
description: Per-datum EGRESS, allow path. The session (auditor-1) reads entry-100 — minting a pt_tag whose audience is exactly {auditor-1} — then posts the returned, pt-untrusted-wrapped content VERBATIM to board-solo, a board only auditor-1 can view. The egress gate must resolve this PER-DATUM: the posted datum's tag audience ({auditor-1}) covers the destination's audience (board-solo readers = {auditor-1}), so it is tool_call_no_leak_per_datum, NOT the coarse floor. This is the whole egress path the four live-only pt-tag bugs broke: mint (write-door + signing), the operator content-binding verify route, and OutboundContent unwrapping the MCP envelope. A regression in any of them drops the decision to *_coarse (visible in the golden) or fails the capture below (no wrapped region to reuse). The post reuses the wrapped region via Expect.Capture, exactly as a real model copies a tool result — the runtime nonce and tag id come from the run, never from this bundle.
